execute: {echo: false, warning: false}
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs: [context/inputs/constanti-pedagogia.json, context/inputs/constanti-ortofoto-2025.png]
  outputs: [assets/img/generated/constanti-recomptes.svg]
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Polygon
from matplotlib.colors import Normalize
from matplotlib.cm import ScalarMappable
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/constanti-pedagogia.json').read_text())
xy=np.array(d['all_points'])/1000;a,b,e,n=np.array(d['bounds'])/1000
image=plt.imread(root/'context/inputs/constanti-ortofoto-2025.png')
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':18,'svg.fonttype':'none','svg.hashsalt':'constanti-recomptes'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(11.5,5.1))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=.025,right=.975,bottom=.30,top=.78,wspace=.07)
cmap=plt.colormaps['YlOrRd'];norm=Normalize(0,125)
for ax in axes:
    ax.imshow(image,extent=[a,e,b,n],alpha=.3)
    ax.set(xlim=(a,e),ylim=(b,n),aspect='equal',xticks=[],yticks=[])
    for spine in ax.spines.values():spine.set_visible(False)
for cell in d['grid']['counts']:
    ring=np.array(cell['geometry']['coordinates'][0])/1000
    axes[0].add_patch(Polygon(ring,facecolor=cmap(norm(cell['n'])) if cell['n'] else 'none',edgecolor='#667781',lw=.4))
axes[0].set_title('Quadrats d’1 km²\nPunts dins de cada quadrat',fontsize=17)
for ax,kernel in zip(axes[1:],d['kernels']):
    values=np.array(kernel['values'],dtype=float)
    ax.imshow(values,extent=np.array(kernel['extent'])/1000,cmap=cmap,norm=norm,origin='upper')
    ax.set_title(f'Kernel de radi {kernel["radius"]} m\nPunts de l’entorn',fontsize=17)
for ax in axes:
    ax.scatter(xy[:,0],xy[:,1],s=10,color='#244b60',edgecolor='white',lw=.2,zorder=5)
    ax.plot([344,346],[4554.7,4554.7],color='#253d48',lw=3);ax.text(345,4554.3,'2 km',ha='center',fontsize=16)
cax=fig.add_axes([.12,.17,.76,.045])
bar=fig.colorbar(ScalarMappable(norm=norm,cmap=cmap),cax=cax,orientation='horizontal',ticks=[0,25,50,75,100,125])
bar.set_label('Registres per km² · mateixa escala de color',fontsize=17)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/constanti-recomptes.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
